# Pre-market brief, Thu Oct 8, 2026 (Research Inc., written ~8:25 AM ET)

**Tone: risk-off open. Oil spike + record-high yields + hawkish Fed are pressuring futures, chips weakest.**

1. **Oil +4% on US-Iran escalation risk.** WTI ~$92.7, Brent above $105, after a report the White House asked the Pentagon to study strike options on Iran; no deal to end the conflict yet. XOM +2.1%, CVX +2.2% pre-market. ([TradingKey](https://www.tradingkey.com/analysis/stocks/us-stocks/262206194-us-premarket-oil-surge-stock-index-futures-fall-avgo-ai-chip-funding-micron-strike-tradingkey))
2. **Futures lower:** Dow -0.87%, S&P -0.49%, Nasdaq-100 -0.73% as of ~8 AM ET ([TradingKey](https://www.tradingkey.com/analysis/stocks/us-stocks/262206194-us-premarket-oil-surge-stock-index-futures-fall-avgo-ai-chip-funding-micron-strike-tradingkey)). S&P closed 7,801.77 Wed ([X](https://x.com/i/trending/2108061472568058039)).
3. **Rates/Fed hawkish:** 10-yr auction cleared at 5.30%, highest since 2000 ([X](https://x.com/i/trending/2108069093836308793)). Sept FOMC minutes: most officials see another hike as possible before year-end; Waller today said more hikes likely needed, not necessarily consecutive ([TradingKey](https://www.tradingkey.com/analysis/stocks/us-stocks/262206194-us-premarket-oil-surge-stock-index-futures-fall-avgo-ai-chip-funding-micron-strike-tradingkey)).
4. **Chips soft:** Samsung's record profit forecast didn't lift the group; NVDA -0.6%, AVGO -1.4%, MU -1.2% pre ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/premarket-movers-palantir-gains-on-bullish-call-nxp-tumbles-on-downgrade-4938587)). WSJ: AVGO arranging $50B+ financing for an OpenAI chip project (early stage). MU Taoyuan union ~99% strike authorization, no date set. ([TradingKey](https://www.tradingkey.com/analysis/stocks/us-stocks/262206194-us-premarket-oil-surge-stock-index-futures-fall-avgo-ai-chip-funding-micron-strike-tradingkey))
5. **Movers:** PLTR +2.3% (Goldman to Buy, $230 PT; Yorkville Ives Outperform, $250). NXPI -2.6% (Citi to Neutral, PT $370 to $260). WOLF +17% ($1.5B conditional federal loan). PEP +2%: Q3 beat but FY EPS growth guide cut to 2.5-3.5%. ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/premarket-movers-palantir-gains-on-bullish-call-nxp-tumbles-on-downgrade-4938587), [TradingKey](https://www.tradingkey.com/analysis/stocks/us-stocks/262206194-us-premarket-oil-surge-stock-index-futures-fall-avgo-ai-chip-funding-micron-strike-tradingkey))
6. **BTC ~$82,500 (-1%)**; spot ETFs saw ~$485M outflows Wed ([X](https://x.com/i/trending/2108063487284900039)).

**Today (ET):** jobless claims 8:30, wholesale inventories 10:00, Kashkari 10:40, 30-yr auction 1:00 ([TradingKey](https://www.tradingkey.com/analysis/stocks/us-stocks/262206194-us-premarket-oil-surge-stock-index-futures-fall-avgo-ai-chip-funding-micron-strike-tradingkey)). **Fri:** UMich sentiment 10:00 ([calendar](https://therighttrader.com/economic-calendar/this-week)). **Next week:** CPI Wed 10/14 8:30, PPI Thu 10/15 ([BLS](https://www.bls.gov/schedule/2026/10_sched_list.htm)); Columbus Day Mon 10/12.

**Earnings (10 days):** DAL 10/9; JPM 10/13 ~7 AM ([JPM IR](https://www.jpmorganchase.com/ir/news/2026/jpmc-to-host-third-quarter-2026-earnings-call)); C, GS, WFC 10/13 pre-open ([Kalkine](https://kalkine.ca/news/financial/when-do-four-big-banks-report-jpmorgan-nysejpm-citigroup-nysec-wells-fargo-nysewfc-goldman-nysegs)); UNH, JNJ 10/13, BAC, BLK 10/14 ([MarketBeat](https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2026-10-13-jpmorgan-chase-co-stock/)). NFLX 10/20 after close ([Netflix IR](https://ir.netflix.net/investor-news-and-events/financial-releases/press-release-details/2026/Netflix-to-Announce-Third-Quarter-2026-Financial-Results/default.aspx)).

## Ideas (long-only)
- **PLTR**, day, gap-and-go: double analyst upgrade/initiation, green against a red tape. Conf: med. Risk: yields/tech selling fades the gap.
- **XOM**, swing: oil risk premium from Iran escalation. Conf: low. Risk: any de-escalation or deal headline reverses oil fast.

**Avoid today:** NXPI (Citi downgrade), MU (strike authorization + chip weakness).
